## Library

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Pi: nucleotide diversity

## Import window and per site data

The raw complete VCF file was used to compute nucleotide diversity values averaged over 1Mb windows. 

```{bash}
#| eval: false
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Calculate nucleotide diversity per 1Mb window
vcftools --gzvcf vfaba_hedin_peamust_SNP_GATK.vcf.gz 
         --window-pi 1000000 
         --out vfaba_hedin_peamust_SNP_GATK.window1Mb.pi

# per site nucleotide diversity
vcftools --site-pi --gzvcf vfaba_hedin_peamust_SNP_GATK.vcf.gz --out vfaba_hedin_peamust_SNP_GATK

# gwas ready file
vcftools --site-pi 
        --gzvcf PEAMUST_vfaba_F1_SNP_imputed_MAF5.vcf.gz 
        --out PEAMUST_vfaba_F1_SNP_imputed_MAF5   
```




```{r}
# Load the data
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pi <- read.delim("./vfaba_hedin_peamust_SNP_GATK.window1Mb.pi", 
                 header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% 
  # remove contigs by filtering on "contig" string
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("contig", CHROM))

sites_pi <- read.delim("./vfaba_hedin_peamust_SNP_GATK.sites.pi", 
                 header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% 
  # remove contigs by filtering on "contig" string
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("contig", CHROM))

sites_pi_gwas <- read.delim("./PEAMUST_vfaba_F1_SNP_imputed_MAF5.sites.pi", 
                 header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% 
  # remove contigs by filtering on "contig" string
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("contig", CHROM))

```


## Plot nucleotide diversity per chromosome

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Plot the data
ggplot(pi, aes(x = BIN_START, y = PI, color = CHROM)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Nucleotide diversity (pi)",
       x = "Position (bp)",
       y = "pi") +
  facet_wrap(~ CHROM, ncol=2) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") 
```

## Average value of Pi

From the raw VCF file.  
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Calculate the average value of Pi from sites data
mean(sites_pi$PI, na.rm = T) %>% 
  round(6) %>% 
  print()
```
From the GWAS ready VCF file.
```{r}
mean(sites_pi_gwas$PI, na.rm = T) %>% 
  round(6) %>% 
  print()
```
